title: HUB24 Group Securities Trading Policy
date_approved: Approved by the HUB24 Limited Board (date not stated)
date_next_review: at least every two years (or more frequently if appropriate)

tiers.name: our People
tiers.description: HUB24, its Subsidiaries and their directors, officers, employees and Contractors (an individual contracted to work for a HUB24 Group member for at least two days a week for at least four weeks). All substantive rules - Restricted Periods, prior written approval, the hedging permissions and restrictions, and the margin lending regime - apply to this tier and to their Associates.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Close family members such as a spouse or partner or dependent children, and any family company or family trust that one or more of our People may control or have an interest in, or that a close family member may control or have an interest in. Our People must take reasonable steps to ensure their Associates do not deal in HUB24 Securities except in accordance with the policy, and the Trade Approval Form requires the Associate to be named.

tiers.name: Designated Person
tiers.description: Any of our People who by virtue of their position or duties are identified by management and Risk and Compliance as requiring additional securities trading requirements. Those additional requirements are given to the Designated Person in writing as management and Risk and Compliance think fit, and are not set out in the Policy.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of HUB24. Approval to trade must come from the Chair of the Board or, in their absence, the Chair of the ARCC. Directors must also notify the Company Secretary immediately after dealing so that ASX can be notified within five business days.

tiers.name: Chair of HUB24's Board
tiers.description: The Board Chair; requests for approval to trade are made to the Chair of the ARCC and, in their absence, the Managing Director. Where the Chair applies to trade in Exceptional Circumstances, the Chair of the ARCC determines whether an Exceptional Circumstance exists.

tiers.name: executive Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Executive KMP excluding the Managing Director; approval required from the Managing Director or, in their absence, the Chair of the ARCC.

tiers.name: Company Secretary
tiers.description: The Company Secretary, who administers the Policy and normally gives approvals; when the Company Secretary wishes to trade, approval must be sought from the Managing Director or, in their absence, the Chair of the ARCC.

definitions.hedging_definition: A hedge includes entering into transactions in financial products that operate to limit the economic risk associated with holding HUB24 Securities.

windows.start_anchor: the balance date, 30 June or 31 December
windows.end_anchor: 24 hours after the release of HUB24's annual or half-yearly results to ASX

windows.start_anchor: one month prior to the issue of a prospectus or other relevant disclosure document in relation to HUB24 Securities
windows.end_anchor: the issue of the prospectus or other relevant disclosure document

windows.start_anchor: the start of the same trading day as any release of Market Sensitive Information to ASX
windows.end_anchor: the end of that trading day

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Section 4.1.4: any other period determined by the Managing Director (or their delegate), the Chief Financial Officer, the Company Secretary, or designated by the HUB24 Board or the Audit Risk and Compliance Committee. Separately, under section 3.1.6.1 the Managing Director, Company Secretary or another officer may direct named individuals in writing not to trade in HUB24 Securities or third-party securities because of their involvement in a transaction or knowledge of information. The Policy does not state whether these directions are confidential, but reasons for approval decisions may be withheld where disclosure would contravene confidentiality obligations, and a refusal must be kept confidential.

rules.detail: HUB24 Securities expressly include a 'derivative in respect of HUB24 shares', with no venue limitation, and section 5.2 confirms that a hedge transaction is treated as trading in HUB24 Securities. A purchased put and written call over vested unrestricted shares may therefore be entered outside Restricted Periods with prior written approval from the relevant approver, using the Annexure A Trade Approval Form.
rules.evidence: For clarity, our People and their Associates are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted HUB24 Securities outside of designated restricted periods provided that the hedge transaction is treated as trading in HUB24 Securities for the purpose of this policy and the relevant approvals have been obtained.

rules.detail: Derivatives that hedge unvested employee share plan securities are prohibited outright, with no approval route.
rules.evidence: Hedge prior to vesting of any unvested HUB24 Securities acquired under the employee share plan operated by HUB24

rules.detail: Securities subject to a holding lock or a restriction on dealing under the employee share plan cannot be hedged, so only fully released shares can be collared.
rules.evidence: Hedge HUB24 Securities subject to a holding lock or restriction on dealing under the terms of the employee share plan

rules.detail: Hedging vested and unrestricted HUB24 Securities is affirmatively permitted, for our People and their Associates alike, outside Restricted Periods and with the relevant approvals. Each hedge is treated as trading in HUB24 Securities, so entry, renewal, alteration and close-out each require their own approval and each is barred during a Restricted Period and while the person holds Inside Information.
rules.evidence: our People and their Associates are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted HUB24 Securities outside of designated restricted periods

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging unvested HUB24 Securities acquired under the HUB24 employee share plan.
rules.evidence: Hedge prior to vesting of any unvested HUB24 Securities acquired under the employee share plan operated by HUB24

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging HUB24 Securities subject to a holding lock or a restriction on dealing under the employee share plan terms.
rules.evidence: Hedge HUB24 Securities subject to a holding lock or restriction on dealing under the terms of the employee share plan

rules.detail: Associates, including family companies and family trusts, may hedge on the same terms; the Trade Approval Form requires the Associate and account name to be identified, and our People must take reasonable steps to ensure Associates comply.
rules.evidence: Will the person trading be one of our People or an Associate? If an Associate, their name

rules.detail: Monetisation structures are not named, but a prepaid forward, collar or exchangeable is a transaction in financial products that operates to limit the economic risk associated with holding HUB24 Securities, so it is a hedge permitted over vested unrestricted holdings with prior written approval and outside Restricted Periods.
rules.evidence: A hedge includes entering into transactions in financial products that operate to limit the economic risk associated with holding HUB24 Securities.

rules.detail: Short selling is not mentioned. A short position taken to limit the economic risk of a holding would be a hedge and so would fall within the section 5.2 permission for vested unrestricted securities; a naked short is not addressed.
Securities lending is not named and there is no dealing definition that would sweep it in.

CFDs are not named. A CFD over HUB24 shares is a derivative in respect of HUB24 shares and therefore a HUB24 Security; where it limits the economic risk of a holding it is a hedge permitted over vested unrestricted securities with approval, and it is prohibited over unvested or holding-locked plan securities.
rules.evidence: derivative in respect of HUB24 shares

rules.detail: Margin loans holding interests in HUB24 Securities are expressly permitted for our People and their Associates, including meeting a margin call. The condition is that sufficient liquidity or alternative securities be maintained in the facility so that HUB24 Securities are not dealt with under a margin call until prior written approval to deal is obtained; dealings under margin lending arrangements are listed as a Restricted Period item and failure to obtain prior approval is a breach. HUB24 warns that no special consideration will be given to the urgency of a margin call and that a request to trade during a Restricted Period will most likely be rejected.
rules.evidence: Our People and their Associates are permitted to have margin loans that have interests in HUB24 Securities under their margin lending arrangement, this includes meeting a 'margin call'.

rules.detail: Granting a charge, mortgage, pledge or lien over HUB24 Securities is not named. The only financing provision is section 6, which permits margin lending arrangements and regulates dealings under them; taking security over HUB24 Securities is not itself treated as a dealing requiring approval.

The Policy addresses only margin lending arrangements and, far from prohibiting them, permits them. There is no general prohibition on secured financing over HUB24 Securities, so a bank loan secured on the collared parcel is not prohibited; but if the facility operates like a margin lending arrangement, section 6 requires prior written approval before any HUB24 Securities are dealt with under it.
rules.evidence: Our People and their Associates are permitted to have margin loans that have interests in HUB24 Securities under their margin lending arrangement

rules.detail: The Policy contains no minimum holding period and no prohibition on short-term or speculative trading; the only timing constraints are the Restricted Periods and the five business day expiry of an approval.

financing.price_trigger_guidance: Our People and their Associates must maintain sufficient liquidity or alternative securities in the margin lending arrangement to ensure that HUB24 Securities are not dealt with under a 'margin call' until prior written approval is obtained to deal in HUB24 Securities. No specific loan-to-value ratio, buffer or price trigger is stated.

exemption_authority: Section 8: our People and their Associates who hold no Inside Information may trade during a Restricted Period only where an Exceptional Circumstance applies and the prior written approval of the Chair of the HUB24 Board or the Chair of the ARCC (where the Managing Director regards that as appropriate) is obtained. Exceptional Circumstances, on the recommendation of the Managing Director or delegate, are financial hardship that cannot be addressed otherwise than by dealing, a court order directing the dealing, and such other situations as the Managing Director or delegate determines. Approval must be in writing and identify an expiry date; an application from someone known to hold Inside Information should prima facie be declined.

bespoke_clauses.clause: For clarity, our People and their Associates are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted HUB24 Securities outside of designated restricted periods provided that the hedge transaction is treated as trading in HUB24 Securities for the purpose of this policy and the relevant approvals have been obtained.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The derivative legs of a collar over vested unrestricted shares are affirmatively permitted, including for Associates such as a family trust, subject only to timing and approval.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Our People and their Associates are permitted to have margin loans that have interests in HUB24 Securities under their margin lending arrangement, this includes meeting a 'margin call'.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unusually, borrowing against HUB24 Securities is expressly allowed rather than banned, so the funding leg of a collar is available in principle.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Our People and their Associates must maintain sufficient liquidity or alternative securities in the margin lending arrangement to ensure that HUB24 Securities are not dealt with under a 'margin call' until prior written approval is obtained to deal in HUB24 Securities. ... regardless of the urgency of a margin call, a margin call that includes a request to trade HUB24 Securities, will only be considered in accordance with this policy and no special consideration is likely to be provided nor approval given.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is the central obstacle: the bank cannot realise the collared shares on short notice, because any sale under the facility needs prior written HUB24 approval that will most likely be refused during a Restricted Period, so the facility must be sized and documented so that enforcement over HUB24 shares is never needed.

bespoke_clauses.topic: margin dealings are a restricted period item
bespoke_clauses.clause: Our People and their Associates may not deal in HUB24 Securities during the following Restricted Periods: ... Dealings in HUB24 Securities under margin lending arrangements - refer to Section 6.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Dealings under a financing arrangement are drafted into the Restricted Period list itself, so they are treated as permanently restricted and always require an approval decision.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Failure by our People or their Associates to obtain prior written approval to deal in HUB24 Securities under a margin lending arrangement is considered a breach of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A lender's unilateral sale exposes the executive to disciplinary action up to dismissal, so the security documents should require notice and a standstill while approval is sought.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Enter into, renew, alter or close out a hedge transaction when they are in possession of Inside Information.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Rolls, restrikes, partial unwinds and terminations are each separately regulated, so the bank cannot rely on unilateral adjustment or early termination rights.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Hedge prior to vesting of any unvested HUB24 Securities acquired under the employee share plan operated by HUB24; Hedge HUB24 Securities subject to a holding lock or restriction on dealing under the terms of the employee share plan
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collateral pool must be limited to shares that have vested and are free of any holding lock or plan dealing restriction.

bespoke_clauses.clause: from the balance date (i.e. 30 June or 31 December) until 24 hours after the release of HUB24's annual or half-yearly results to ASX
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Roughly four months of each year are closed, plus a month before any prospectus and each Market Sensitive announcement day, so entry, roll and unwind must be scheduled into the open periods.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any approval expires: within five (5) business days of the date of the approval; or such other period as is agreed by the Company Secretary ... any approved but incomplete trades will lapse at the expiry and new approval to must be sought.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The five business day window can be extended by agreement, which is useful for a negotiated OTC trade that cannot be executed as quickly as an on-market order.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Approvals can be withheld where it's reasonable to believe that the person seeking approval is in possession of Inside Information or for reasons of good corporate governance or for other reasons taking into account matters such HUB24's trading activities and proposed transactions.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Approval for a collar can be refused on general corporate governance grounds without reasons, and any refusal must be kept confidential from the bank.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Approval requests will generally be answered within one business day after their receipt, provided those requests are received prior to 3pm on a business day and all relevant information is provided.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A one business day service standard makes it practical to obtain approval close to pricing, reducing market risk between approval and execution.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Person includes any of our People who by virtue of their position and or duties are identified by management and Risk and Compliance as requiring additional securities trading requirements to be applied to them.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Additional, unpublished trading restrictions may be imposed in writing on a particular executive, so the bank should ask for confirmation of whether the client is a Designated Person and what extra requirements apply.

summary: HUB24 is among the most permissive ASX policies for this structure: section 5.2 expressly permits our People and their Associates to hedge vested and unrestricted HUB24 Securities outside Restricted Periods with the relevant approvals, and section 6 expressly permits margin loans holding interests in HUB24 Securities, so both the derivative and the funded legs of a collar are contemplated rather than banned. The conditions are prior written approval on the Annexure A Trade Approval Form (Chair of the Board or ARCC Chair for Directors, the Managing Director for executive KMP, the Company Secretary for everyone else), generally answered within one business day and expiring after five business days unless a longer period is agreed, execution outside the Restricted Periods (balance date to 24 hours after results, one month before a prospectus, each Market Sensitive announcement day, and any ad hoc period), and no Inside Information at entry, renewal, alteration or close-out. Unvested plan securities and shares subject to a holding lock or plan dealing restriction cannot be hedged, so the collateral must be fully released stock; there is no short-term trading ban or minimum holding period. The main structuring constraint is enforcement: HUB24 Securities must not be dealt with under a margin call until prior written approval is obtained, HUB24 warns that no special consideration will be given to the urgency of a margin call and that requests during a Restricted Period will most likely be rejected, and an unapproved dealing is a breach of the Policy. A funded collar should therefore be documented with conservative leverage, non-HUB24 substitute collateral or cash liquidity, and a contractual standstill while HUB24 approval is sought before any enforcement sale.
